reviewer: Codex synthetic challenge author, not independent human labels
provenance: Same eight synthetic challenge cases projected into the production V2 company/JD text builder; equivalent company variants fill one ten-role batch. No production data.

orderingChecks.reason: Company quality evidence differs while candidate, job, size and pay are held constant.
Absent company-quality evidence should not be conflated with demonstrated weak quality.
Disclosed pay is substantially below candidate preference.
Current explicit tradeoffs take priority over inferred pedigree expectations and stale Behavior.
Job performance evidence, not company attraction, governs roleFit.
Employer screening requires actual relevant experience.
Hybrid attendance violates explicit remote-only condition.
The explicit conflict reduces mutual suitability.

qualitativeChecks: Strong company quality can be attractive at either size; inspect quality-small-strong vs quality-strong without assuming an exact equality.
quality-unknown must expose evidence gaps, including company quality; high roleFit does not establish sufficient overall evidence.
capability-gap must not convert candidate fascination into work capability.
Pedigree informs likely expectations, not rigid prestige cutoffs or hard requirements.
Check all six raw distributions, not just ordering.
Inspect equivalent same-evidence roles for material score instability within the ten-role batch.
Verify rerank notes (separate review) are compact, specific and correctly distinguish uncertainty from a downside.
releaseGate: Exploratory challenge only; not independent correctness or probability calibration.
